Second first-run must reject HANDLE_CURRENT with exact handle bytes/dispatch count unchanged.
testContract.secondRun: After first execute leaves a current handle, snapshot handle bytes/source refs/worktree status and dispatch count. A second direct runSupervisedBackendWork using that recoveryDir rejects RecoveryError HANDLE_CURRENT before a new fake dispatch or worktree; count and bytes remain unchanged. Dispose the matching handle only in test cleanup.
testContract.omitted: Register invocationObserver to retain the fake invocation cwd; invoke runSupervisedBackendWork with recoveryDir omitted and check cwd removed after completion. No handle artifact in source; compare source HEAD/refs/status. Empty/non-string directory rejects before fake dispatch. Adapter adds only first-execute forwarding; Board-owned recover/resume contract is unchanged.
testContract.persistencePhase: Handle is required at ACT_COMPLETED verification and after execute return; never inside first invocationObserver.
